neighbours.label: Describes the physical conversion or delivery of energy inside power-generation and heating equipment.
fire: At the geothermal station, hot water passes through a heat exchanger before returning underground.
A rooftop photovoltaic system needs an inverter that changes the panels' DC output into usable AC.
In the gas-fired plant, expanding hot gases spin the turbine blades and drive the generator.
The offshore wind turbine rests on a floating support held in place by cables to the seabed.
Inside the fuel cell, hydrogen reacts with oxygen to generate electricity and release heat.
The solar thermal collector pumps heated fluid through insulated pipes to a storage tank.
At the hydroelectric dam, falling water turns a runner that transfers torque to the generator shaft.
The combined heat and power unit recovers exhaust heat to warm water for nearby homes.
quiet: Residents endorsed a geothermal project because they hoped it would create steady local employment.
Several homeowners supported the subsidy for rooftop photovoltaic systems during the council debate.
The gas-fired plant changed ownership after shareholders approved the company's restructuring proposal.
An offshore wind development received public support from groups campaigning for cleaner energy.
Investors expect the hydrogen fuel-cell industry to gain market share over the coming decade.
The solar thermal project was postponed after the contractor withdrew from the tender process.
Environmental organizations challenged the hydroelectric dam's permit at a public hearing last week.
A housing association announced a financing agreement for its proposed combined heat and power project.

notes: Both poles concern energy: the opposite pole favors energy sources, while this pole peaks on how equipment works. Probes separated hardware operation from energy policy, and floating wind platforms from an unrelated floating object. No precomputed band array was available.
